grade.message: We booked four hotels for a 17 day family trip back in May. We got to the Lakeside Inn (LKE14A) at 11 pm and the fire department had shut the building. The manager squeezed the five of us into a two-queen room somewhere else for the night. Next morning your agents cancelled the Lakeside and booked us into River North (RNE14B) for the three nights, and we paid $560 for that, which is $80 more than the Lakeside's $480. Now the Lakeside booking shows as a late cancel with nothing back! A refund or a credit on my account, either is fine, for the Lakeside booking. And we shouldn't be paying more for a room we were forced into, so we shouldn't pay the $80 extra. Our other two hotels later in the trip are fine. The $80 is the only extra cost I am asking about. Claim the $80 on the Lakeside booking, and if the Lakeside refuses it, just tell me; do not open anything else. brian.kowalczyk@example.com, card 6414.
